nodes.description: Token balance mapping mutated by _transferStandard, _transferNoTax and takeFees; read for balanceOf and wallet checks.
Timestamp of last transfer per address; used for the 3 minute buy cooldown check.
Nested allowance mapping written by _approve and consumed by transferFrom.
Fee exemption flag mapping; controls takeFee branch and gating of trading/max-tx checks.
Fixed total supply minted to the deployer in the constructor.
Currently active transfer tax percentage, read by takeFees.
Blacklist mapping toggled by blockBots/unblockBot and checked in _transfer.
Fee recipient address that receives ETH via sendETHToFee.
External Uniswap V2 router used for swaps and liquidity additions.
Uniswap pair address used to determine buy/sell direction and fee logic.
Gate flag toggled by setTrading; blocks transfers until enabled.
Reentrancy lock set by the lockTheSwap modifier around swapTokensForEth.
Flag controlling whether contract tokens are auto-swapped for ETH.
Flag enabling the 3 minute cooldown between buys.
Maximum transfer amount enforced in _transfer for non-exempt accounts.
Maximum wallet balance enforced in _transfer.
Contract token balance threshold that triggers an automatic swap.
Owner address used by onlyOwner authorization checks.
Public ERC20 transfer; forwards to _transfer with msg.sender as sender.
Public ERC20 transferFrom; performs _transfer then decrements allowance via _approve.
Public ERC20 approve; delegates to _approve.
Internal allowance writer with zero-address checks.
Core transfer routine: enforces trading/max-tx/wallet/blacklist/cooldown checks, triggers swap-and-liquify, writes _lastTX and calls _tokenTransfer.
Internal swap of contract tokens for ETH via router, then routes part of ETH to addLiquidity; guarded by lockTheSwap.
Internal ETH payout to _marketingAddress using transfer.
Internal liquidity addition calling router.addLiquidityETH with ETH value.
Owner-only toggle enabling or disabling trading.
Owner-only manual trigger of swapTokensForEth on the full contract balance.
Owner-only blacklist of an array of addresses.
Owner-only removal of a single address from the blacklist.
Internal dispatcher that chooses taxed or untaxed transfer path.
Owner-only batch untaxed transfer from msg.sender to a list of recipients.
Taxed balance update path: computes fee via takeFees then credits recipient.
Untaxed balance update path used by airdrop and exempt transfers.
Internal fee computation crediting the contract and returning the net amount.
Payable receive hook that accepts ETH sent to the contract.
Owner-only ownership handover that also rewires the fee-exemption of old/new owner.
Owner-only setter for buy and sell tax rates.
Owner-only setter for the max transaction amount.
Owner-only setter for the max wallet size.
Owner-only toggle of fee exemption for an address.
Owner-only toggle of the transfer cooldown delay.
Owner-only toggle of automatic swapping.
Owner-only setter for the swap trigger threshold.
Returns the stored owner address used in the onlyOwner check.
Internal owner state update emitting OwnershipTransferred.
Caller-controlled address used for sender identity and authorization checks.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for the buy cooldown and as swap/liquidity deadline.
Origin address used as the cooldown key and _lastTX writer.
External call to uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with zero slippage bound.
External payable call to router.addLiquidityETH with zero slippage bounds.
ETH value transfer to _marketingAddress using the low-level transfer.
Fee arithmetic amount.mul(_taxFee).div(100) whose divisor and rate are owner-controlled.
Source address parameter of _transfer.
Destination address parameter of _transfer.
Amount parameter of _transfer.
Debited address parameter of the taxed transfer path.
Recipient parameter of the public transfer entrypoints.
Spender parameter of approve/allowance.
Allowance owner parameter of _approve.
Token amount to swap and partially add as liquidity.
ETH amount forwarded as value to addLiquidityETH.
New owner address parameter, gated by onlyOwner.
Array of addresses to blacklist.
Address to remove from the blacklist.
Array of airdrop destination addresses.
Array of airdrop amounts paired with recipients.
New max transaction amount value, owner-only.
New max wallet size value, owner-only.
Address whose fee exemption is set.
Exemption boolean value.
Boolean value that opens or closes trading.
Clamped contract token balance considered for swapping.
Boolean gate deciding whether the automatic swap runs.
Boolean deciding taxed versus untaxed transfer path.
Net amount credited to the recipient after fees.
Computed fee credited to the contract address.
Contract ETH balance snapshot taken before the swap.
ETH received from the swap, derived from the balance delta.
85 percent of the token amount routed to the router swap.
Remaining token amount reserved for liquidity addition.
Contract token balance swapped during manualswap.
Loop index over the airdrop recipient array.
Previous owner cached before the ownership write.
Swap path array [token, WETH] built in memory.

edges.reason: transfer uses the caller address as the sender.
transferFrom uses the caller as the spender for the allowance update.
approve writes an allowance for the caller.
setTrading is restricted by the onlyOwner check against _msgSender().
manualswap is restricted by onlyOwner.
blockBots is restricted by onlyOwner.
unblockBot is restricted by onlyOwner.
airdrop debits msg.sender and is onlyOwner protected.
transferOwnership is restricted by onlyOwner.
setFees is restricted by onlyOwner.
setMaxTxnAmount is restricted by onlyOwner.
setMaxWalletSize is restricted by onlyOwner.
setIsFeeExempt is restricted by onlyOwner.
toggleTransferDelay is restricted by onlyOwner.
toggleSwap is restricted by onlyOwner.
setMinSwapTokensThreshold is restricted by onlyOwner.
owner() is invoked to compare the caller against the stored owner.
the caller identity decides whether owner-only state changes execute.
the buy cooldown check depends on block.timestamp.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
the transfer timestamp is persisted into _lastTX for the cooldown gate.
tx.origin is used as the cooldown key inside _transfer.
_lastTX[tx.origin] is written, coupling state to the transaction origin.
transfer delegates the state update to _transfer.
transferFrom performs the token movement through _transfer.
transferFrom rewrites the allowance via _approve.
approve delegates to _approve.
_approve writes the nested allowance mapping.
_transfer updates the cooldown timestamps for tx.origin and the recipient.
_transfer reads and indirectly mutates balances through the token transfer path.
_transfer finishes by dispatching to _tokenTransfer.
the automatic swap-and-ETH-payout executes inside _transfer before balances are updated.
_transfer sends contract ETH out through sendETHToFee mid-execution.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call with a zero slippage bound.
swapTokensForEth routes part of the proceeds into addLiquidity.
the router instance is used for the WETH lookup and swap call.
addLiquidity forwards ETH to the external router with zero slippage bounds.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to the marketing address with transfer.
the marketing address is the receiver of the ETH payout.
sendETHToFee reads the marketing address before transferring.
taxed path selected when takeFee is true.
untaxed path selected when takeFee is false.
_transferStandard computes the fee through takeFees.
_transferStandard debits the sender and credits the recipient balance.
_transferNoTax moves balances without any fee.
takeFees credits the contract balance with the fee.
the fee amount derives from owner-controlled multiplication and division.
the active tax rate feeds the fee arithmetic.
takeFees reads the mutable tax rate.
airdrop moves each entry with the untaxed transfer helper.
manualswap invokes swapTokensForEth on the whole contract balance.
manualswap reads the contract token balance from the balance mapping.
blockBots writes the blacklist mapping.
unblockBot clears a blacklist entry.
setIsFeeExempt writes the exemption mapping.
setMaxTxnAmount writes the max transaction amount.
setMaxWalletSize writes the wallet cap.
setMinSwapTokensThreshold writes the swap threshold.
toggleSwap flips the swap enabled flag.
toggleTransferDelay flips the cooldown flag.
setTrading writes the trading gate.
setFees changes the rate used in the fee arithmetic.
transferOwnership delegates the owner write to _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership overwrites the stored owner.
transferOwnership rewires the fee exemption of the outgoing and incoming owner.
owner() reads the stored owner address.
the exemption mapping gates all trading restrictions in _transfer.
the pair address determines buy versus sell direction and wallet checks.
the max transaction amount is enforced in _transfer.
the delay flag gates the cooldown requirement.
the blacklist mapping blocks transfers.
the wallet cap is enforced in _transfer.
the swap threshold decides the auto-swap amount.
swapEnabled gates the automatic swap branch.
the inSwap lock suppresses nested swaps.
the lockTheSwap modifier sets and clears inSwap around the swap body.
the trading gate must be opened by the owner before transfers succeed.
the stored router is used for approval and the swap call.
_transfer reads contract and account balances from the balance mapping.
swapTokensForEth reads the contract balance for its accounting.
from supplies the debited address to _transfer.
to supplies the credited address to _transfer.
amount drives all limit checks inside _transfer.
amount is the base for the fee multiplication.
sender is the debited address in the taxed path.
sender is the debited address in the untaxed path.
recipient receives the transferred tokens.
recipient receives the transferred tokens in transferFrom.
recipient is credited in the taxed balance update.
spender receives the allowance.
ownerParam keys the allowance mapping write.
tokenAmount is split into the swap and liquidity portions.
ethAmount is forwarded as msg.value to the router.
newOwner becomes the privileged owner controlling all onlyOwner setters.
bots_ entries are written into the blacklist.
notbot is cleared from the blacklist.
recipients drives the airdrop loop destination.
amounts drives the airdrop loop value.
maxTxAmount rewrites the transfer limit used by the trading gate.
maxWalletSize rewrites the wallet cap enforced on transfers.
holder becomes fee exempt, bypassing trading restrictions.
exempt decides whether the holder skips fees and limits.
tradingOpenParam opens trading, unlocking transfer restrictions.
contractTokenBalance caps the swapped amount.
canSwap gates whether the swap routine runs.
takeFee selects the taxed or untaxed branch.
amountReceived is the net amount after the fee subtraction.
feeAmount is the product of amount and the tax rate.
balanceBefore is the pre-swap ETH snapshot used for delta accounting.
amountETH is the post-swap ETH available for liquidity.
ethAmt is the amountIn passed to the router swap.
liqAmt is the token amount passed to addLiquidity.
contractBalance is passed to the swap routine.
i bounds the airdrop iteration.
oldOwner is emitted and replaced in _transferOwnership.
path is the swap route passed to the router.
the router swap pulls tokens back through the token transfer entrypoints, re-entering _transfer.
addLiquidityETH calls back into the token transfer path during the locked swap.
the ETH payout to the marketing address can trigger a contract fallback that re-enters the token.
